headline.purpose: Card titles: selected font name, drop-target title, empty and error states.

title.purpose: Panel headings (Pages, Changes); file name at 0.9375rem.

caption.purpose: Metadata, badges, field labels, keep-until text. Sentence case.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: the bottom bar, selection card, sheets, toast, hint, dragged items.

shadows.name: page
shadows.purpose: PDF pages and the upload paper sheet.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Press feedback only: :active scale (0.97 buttons, 0.98 selected block, 0.94 swatches), 220-260ms. Never on entrances. Detector ignore in .impeccable/config.json is scoped to this use.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every entrance, lift and sheet rise (300-340ms); counter bump 420ms.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Background, colour and shadow changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The ultramarine pill; one per surface for the main action (Download, Choose a PDF).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.25" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 15V3"/><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/></svg>Download</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; min-width:44px; padding:0 16px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #2b1d16); font-family:var(--font-ui, Nunito, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight:700; font-size:0.9375rem; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.32, 0.64, 1), background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-btn svg { width:20px; height:20px; flex:none; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #3b34e6); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background:var(--action, #3b34e6); color:var(--on-action, #fff); padding:0 24px; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgb(59 52 230 / 0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--action-press, #2c25c4); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background:var(--line-strong, #e4cbbb); color:var(--ink-2, #6e5243); box-shadow:none; cursor:not-allowed; transform:none; }

components.name: Soft Button

components.name: Toggle Button
components.description: Ghost tool button; pressed state takes the ultramarine wash.
components.css: .ds-btn-tool { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #2b1d16); font-family:var(--font-ui, Nunito, ui-rounded, sans-serif); font-weight:700; font-size:0.9375rem; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.32, 0.64, 1), background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-tool:hover { background:var(--card-sunk, #fbf1ea); } .ds-btn-tool:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-tool[aria-pressed="true"] { background:rgb(59 52 230 / 0.1); color:var(--action, #3b34e6); } .ds-btn-tool:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #3b34e6); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { width:280px; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:2px solid var(--line-strong, #e4cbbb); border-radius:14px; background:var(--card, #fff); color:var(--ink, #2b1d16); font-family:var(--font-ui, Nunito, ui-rounded, sans-serif); font-size:1.0625rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-3, #87685a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--action, #3b34e6); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgb(59 52 230 / 0.1); }

components.name: Bottom Bar
components.description: The one persistent editor toolbar, thumb-reachable, Download at the right.
components.css: .ds-bar { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; padding:8px; min-height:72px; border-radius:28px; background:var(--card, #fff); box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgb(73 35 14 / 0.08), 0 18px 40px -8px rgb(73 35 14 / 0.24); font-family:var(--font-ui, Nunito, ui-rounded, sans-serif); } .ds-bar-tool { position:relative; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #2b1d16); font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:0.9375rem; cursor:pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.32, 0.64, 1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-bar-tool:hover { background:var(--card-sunk, #fbf1ea); } .ds-bar-tool:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-bar-tool:focus-visible, .ds-bar-dl:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--action, #3b34e6); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-bar-sep { width:1px; height:28px; margin:0 4px; background:var(--line-strong, #e4cbbb); } .ds-bar-changes { margin-right:6px; } .ds-bar-count { position:absolute; top:-3px; right:-6px; min-width:20px; height:20px; padding:0 5px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--action, #3b34e6); color:#fff; font-size:12px; font-weight:850; line-height:20px; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff; } .ds-bar-dl { margin-left:8px; min-height:52px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--action, #3b34e6); color:#fff; font:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:0.9375rem; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -6px rgb(59 52 230 / 0.6); cursor:pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.32, 0.64, 1), background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-bar-dl:hover { background:var(--action-press, #2c25c4); } .ds-bar-dl:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.description: Plain-language status row; font substitution adds a Deep Apricot ring. No extra hues.
components.html: This font is missing “é”, so the edit uses Liberation Sans.
components.css: .ds-note { display:flex; gap:8px; margin:0; padding:12px; max-width:320px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--card-sunk, #fbf1ea); color:var(--ink, #2b1d16); font-family:var(--font-ui, Nunito, ui-rounded, sans-serif); font-size:0.9375rem; line-height:1.45; } .ds-note svg { flex:none; width:18px; height:18px; margin-top:2px; color:var(--ink-2, #6e5243); } .ds-note-swap { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ground-deep, #efc8b0); }

narrative.overview:
This is a warm consumer app, not a PDF tool. A pinkish-apricot ground holds the user's own page, centred, large and shadowed like a real sheet of paper; everything else is a soft white card that says in plain words what it is and what will happen. Controls collect into two floating pieces of furniture (a slim file pill at the top, a persistent bottom bar within thumb reach) and a selection card that appears only when something is selected. There is no icon ribbon, no permanent thumbnail sidebar, no properties panel.

The palette is warm and almost monochrome: apricot ground, white card, warm near-black ink, warm grey secondary text. One saturated ultramarine marks the things you can press and the thing you have selected. Status (a substituted font, a deleted file, an edited block) speaks through ink, icons and plain sentences in a card row, never through extra hues.

Type is one rounded humanist sans (Nunito, variable, self-hosted) run at comfortable sizes with heavy weights (800-900) for headings and labels, and tabular figures wherever a number is a measurement. Touch targets never drop below 44px. Motion is soft: entrances ease out, sheets rise from the bottom, and only a press gets a spring.
keyCharacteristics: Apricot ground, white cards, one ultramarine action colour.
The document is the only large object; chrome floats around it as cards.
Large soft radii: 20px cards, 28px bar, 999px pills; paper keeps tight 4-6px corners.
Warm-tinted, diffuse shadows (brown, never grey or black).
Nunito at heavy weights, tabular figures for sizes and positions.
44px minimum hit area on every control.
Spring on press only; ease-out for every entrance.

rules.name: The Pressable Ultramarine Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine marks what you can press, what is pressed, and what is selected or focused. Disabled controls lose it entirely (disabled primary falls to Rule Blush on Cocoa Grey). It never colours status, decoration or headings.

rules.name: The No Extra Hues Rule
rules.body: Status never adds a colour. Substituted fonts, deleted files and edited blocks are told with an icon, ink, a plain sentence and, where needed, a Deep Apricot ring. Changed-block markers are Cocoa Grey dots (a diamond when the font was swapped), never ultramarine.

rules.name: The White-Only Faint Rule
rules.body: Faint Cocoa (ink-3) passes contrast only on Card White. Never set it on the apricot ground or on Sunk Blush; use Cocoa Grey there.

rules.name: The Tabular Measurement Rule
rules.body: Any number that is a size, position, zoom, page count or time uses tabular figures (the `num` utility: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`).

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Interface type is Nunito only; weight does the work a second family would.

rules.name: The Page Leads Rule
rules.body: Nothing except the paper is large. Chrome lives in floating cards at the edges; panels appear on demand and leave when dismissed.

rules.name: The Thumb Bar Rule
rules.body: Primary editor actions live in the one bottom bar, with Download as the ultramarine pill at its right end.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted warm brown (rgb 73 35 14), or ultramarine for action and selection. Never neutral grey or black.

dos: Do keep the PDF page the only large object; float all chrome as white cards on the apricot ground.
Do reserve ultramarine (#3b34e6) for pressable, pressed, selected and focused things; strip it from disabled controls.
Do report status with an icon, ink and one plain sentence in a Sunk Blush note row.

Do use the spring curve (cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.32, 0.64, 1)) only for `:active` press feedback (scale 0.94-0.98), and the ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) for every entrance, lift and sheet rise.
Do keep every control at least 44px in both directions.
Do tint all shadows warm brown (rgb 73 35 14) or ultramarine for action.
Do set measurements in tabular figures.
Do turn all motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't build an icon ribbon, a permanent thumbnail sidebar or a properties panel.
Don't introduce extra status hues (no green success, amber warning or red error fills); errors are bold Warm Ink text.
Don't bounce or spring an entrance; the spring belongs to presses only.
Don't set Faint Cocoa (#87685a) on the apricot ground or Sunk Blush.
Don't shift the ground toward cream; it stays pinkish apricot.
Don't use grey/black or hard-offset shadows.
Don't use the Ed Sans/Serif/Mono document fonts for interface text.
